item_name: Smith & Wesson Extreme Ops Liner Lock Folding Knife
item_short_desc: The Smith & Wesson® Extreme Ops Liner Lock Folding Knife is made with a black high carbon stainless steel partially serrated clip point blade.
description: The Smith & Wesson® Extreme Ops Liner Lock Folding Knife is made with a black high carbon stainless steel partially serrated clip point blade. This knife has ambidextrous thumb knobs, jimping, and an index flipper. The black aluminum handle comes with jimping and a pocket clip.
